name: media-modal-default
blurb: Grid gallery of zoomable images and videos ready to use.
description: A pre-configured 2-column grid of media modals displaying images and videos side-by-side. Each item expands to fullscreen when clicked. Ready to drop in with default styling and layout.
use_when: You need a quick gallery without composing multiple media modals.
avoid_when: You need custom grid layouts or single-column layouts.
a11y: Each media item respects Escape to close and backdrop clicks. Inherits accessibility from underlying MediaModal components.
